title: Billing and Coding: Measurement of Salivary Hormones

codes.1: Because current CPT® codes do not specify or identify “salivary” hormone testing from serum or urine hormone testing, claims for salivary levels of hormone should be coded with NOS code 84999 and the words “salivary cortisol”. For other than cortisol use “salivary (name of other hormone)” which will generate a denial.
